name: ljosalfar_adept
description: a Ljosalfar Adept (Fall from Heaven), a young elf woman with long blonde hair and a pointed ear: a deep green hooded robe with white trim and a hem cut into leaf shapes, a brown leather strap across the chest to a brown satchel stuffed with scrolls at her screen-left hip, brown boots, and a gnarled wooden staff topped with a glowing blue crystal and green leaves in her LEFT hand
hands: the crystal-topped staff stays upright in her left hand on the screen-right side, its foot near the ground; her right hand on the screen-left side is an empty hand resting on the satchel strap

flinch.0: impact: hit from the lower-right; head snaps back toward the upper-left, eyes squeezed shut, torso jolts back, both arms jerk outward (her empty right hand flung out to the left, the crystal-topped staff thrown up and out in her left hand), the green hood and blonde hair jolting back
flinch.1: recoil extreme: leaning back further, knees bent, the crystal-topped staff tilting back, her empty right hand still held out

death.1: stagger back: a step back with the near foot, body thrown back, staff arm flung up holding the crystal-topped staff high, her empty right hand drooping
death.2: knees buckle: hips drop, knees fold forward, torso slumps forward, head droops, the crystal-topped staff lowering
death.3: kneeling: on both knees, slumped forward, the crystal end of the staff resting on the ground at the lower-right, her empty right hand hanging by the satchel
death.4: falling back: torso tips back toward the upper-left, the crystal-topped staff slips out of the hand, legs slide forward, the leaf-hemmed robe flaring
death.5: hits the ground: lying on her back along the ground, feet toward the lower-right and head toward the upper-left, blonde hair spread on the ground; the crystal-topped staff lies on the ground at the lower-right; the satchel lies flat beside her
death.6: bounce: head and shoulders lift slightly off the ground, the green hood and robe settle
death.7: corpse: lying flat and still on her back, eyes closed, the crystal-topped staff on the ground beside her, its crystal dark
